Card Q&A.a: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?

Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area by an opponent's effect, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent it from leaving.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an effect trashes from your security stack, this Digimon with [Leon Alexander] in its digivolution cards may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text in the hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, by trashing the top card of your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
